apple_apple_scab.symptoms: Concentric ring spots, dark brown to black necrotic lesions, leaf blight, target-like halos, and premature leaf drop on Apple.
apple_apple_scab.organic_treatment: Spray copper sulfate Bordeaux mixture (1%), bio-agent Trichoderma viride or Pseudomonas fluorescens; prune infected bottom leaves.
apple_apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP (2 g/L), Chlorothalonil 75% WP, or Carbendazim 50% WP / Azoxystrobin.
apple_apple_scab.prevention: Practice minimum 3-year crop rotation; avoid overhead irrigation; clean up fallen infected crop debris after harvest.

apple_cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Orange, reddish-brown, or yellow pustules (uredinia) on upper and lower surfaces of Apple leaves, leading to chlorosis and premature defoliation.
apple_cedar_apple_rust.organic_treatment: Apply wettable sulfur dust or potassium bicarbonate spray; foliar spray of neem oil (0.5%) combined with bio-fungicide Trichoderma.
apple_cedar_apple_rust.chemical_treatment: Foliar spray with Propiconazole (Tilt 25% EC @ 1ml/L) or Tebuconazole + Trifloxystrobin.
apple_cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Plant rust-resistant cultivars; eradicate alternate weed hosts around field margins; practice timely sowing and avoid dense planting.

bell_pepper_bacterial_spot.symptoms: Water-soaked circular to angular lesions with chlorotic yellow halos on Bell Pepper foliage, potential stem cankers and leaf drop.

cherry_powdery_mildew.symptoms: Powdery white or grayish felt-like patches on Cherry leaf surfaces, causing leaf curling, stunting, and reduced photosynthetic capacity.

cherry_powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin 23% SC or Myclobutanil / Difenoconazole applied at initial disease onset.
cherry_powdery_mildew.prevention: Ensure generous plant spacing for good ventilation; avoid planting in deep shade; prune dense center canopy.

lemon_curl_virus.cause: Viral Pathogen (transmitted via insect vectors like Whiteflies/Aphids)
lemon_curl_virus.symptoms: Mottling, mosaic pattern, leaf curling, puckering, vein clearing, severe stunting, and shoestring deformities on Lemon.
lemon_curl_virus.organic_treatment: Immediately remove and burn infected plants to halt field spread; spray neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) to repel vector insects.
lemon_curl_virus.chemical_treatment: No direct chemical cure for viruses; control vector insects with Acetamiprid 20% SP or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (0.3 ml/L).
lemon_curl_virus.prevention: Use yellow sticky traps; install insect-proof netting (40-50 mesh); use virus-resistant certified hybrid seeds.
